attributes.residual: TWO RESULTS, both screens rather than probes. (1) THE CENSUS TAIL IS RANKED THE OTHER WAY ROUND. Fresh `regnorm.py game/game/combat`, 44 paired functions, 36 reading EXACT. Ranked nearest-first by GENUINE structural rows, the tail is: StandardCamera 5 genuine (COUNT+3), get_attn_pos 0 genuine (PARITY, 4 unpaired), EnemyStartMissile 0 genuine (COUNT-1), PlayerStartMissile 35 (COUNT+5, slots 4T/3O), InitPlayerMissiles 38 (COUNT+1), someone_will_be_off_screen 39 (PARITY, slots 10T/8O), get_cam_wpos 44 (COUNT+8, slots 4T/4O), screen_limitation 48 (COUNT-7, slots 0T/1O), InitCamera 56 (COUNT-7, slots 16T/15O). InitCamera is the FARTHEST member of the tail, not the nearest, and it is also the only one carrying a double-digit slot delta on both sides, i.e. a frame residual on top of its structural one. Any lane told to work this tail 'nearest-first' should start at the missile pair, not at InitCamera. (2) InitPlayerMissiles' RELOCATION-SYMBOL DIVERGENCE, resolved to addresses. Target set minus ours: lbl_80118DF8(ADDR16_HA/LO), lbl_80111DE0(ADDR16_HA/LO), pmissile_sfxidx(ADDR16_HA/LO), lbl_803463DC / lbl_803463E4 / lbl_803463EC(EMB_SDA21). Ours minus target's: PlayerMissileDesc(ADDR16_HA) x2 and (ADDR16_LO) x2, DmgTypeDesc(ADDR16_HA/LO), PhoenixTree(EMB_SDA21), @@2142 / @@2143 / @@2144(EMB_SDA21), plus the ...bss.0 and ...rodata.0 aliases. Resolved against config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt: lbl_80118DF8 = .data 0x80118DF8, PlayerMissileDesc = .data 0x80118E28 = lbl_80118DF8 + 0x30, DmgTypeDesc = .data 0x801190E8 = lbl_80118DF8 + 0x2F0. Both of our separately-materialised .data symbols are therefore inside 16-bit displacement range of the ONE base the target materialises at 0x4/0x18, which is exactly the shared-aggregate shape and exactly the axis attempt.initplayermissiles-shared-aggregate-regression.20260830.v1 already recorded as a regression - so the new law predicts that park rather than reopening it. THE GENUINELY UNSCREENED ROWS, left for the next lane: our surplus PhoenixTree(EMB_SDA21) reference, which the target does not emit at all and which is NOT explained by any base-sharing (PhoenixTree is .bss 0x80240624, a different section from the .data base), and the three anonymous sdata2 pool entries @@2142/@@2143/@@2144 against the target's named lbl_803463DC/E4/EC, which symbols.txt marks `data:string` - a string-literal pool respell, a different class from the float-pool respell blocked on get_cam_wpos.
